description.zh:
要查询的DDoS原生防护实例的ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~)查询所有DDoS原生防护实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance to query.

> Call [DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.
The protected IP address to query.
The UID of the member account.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。
description.en: The number of the page to return.

description.zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含受保护IP的数量。最大值：50。
description.en: The number of protected IP addresses to return on each page. The maximum value is 50.

description.zh:
要查询的受保护IP所属云资产类型。取值：

- **ECS**：表示云服务器ECS实例。
- **SLB**：表示传统型负载均衡CLB（原SLB）实例。
- **EIP**：表示弹性公网IP实例。因公网应用型负载均衡ALB实例使用弹性公网IP，您需要通过EIP实例查询ALB的公网IP。
- **WAF**：表示Web应用防火墙实例。
description.en:
The type of the cloud asset to which the protected IP address belongs. Valid values:

- **ECS**: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

- **SLB**: a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

- **EIP**: an Elastic IP Address (EIP) instance. Because Application Load Balancer (ALB) instances use EIPs, query the public IP address of an ALB instance using the EIP.

- **WAF**: a Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

> Call [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) to query the IDs of all regions that Anti-DDoS Origin supports.

description.zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

title.zh: 查询防护包的防护IP列表信息

descriptions.zh:
本接口用于分页查询单个DDoS原生防护实例的防护IP列表，例如，IP地址、IP所属云资产类型、IP的当前状态（是否处于黑洞状态）等。

### QPS限制

本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用将会被限流，这可能影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to query a paginated list of protected IP addresses for an Anti-DDoS Origin instance. The query returns details such as the IP addresses, the types of cloud assets to which the IP addresses belong, and their current status, such as whether they are under blackhole filtering.

### QPS limit

This operation has a queries per second (QPS) limit of 10 for each user. Calls that exceed this limit are throttled, which may affect your business. We recommend that you call this operation within this limit.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp describe-pack-ip-list --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz0000 --ip 47.98.XX.XX --product-name ECS --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --member-uid 1708588696790000 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
